patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are used frequently, pairing large text areas with complementary graphics or device mockups on the opposing side.
A sophisticated serif typeface is used for prominent headings, creating an editorial feel, contrasted with a clean, highly readable sans-serif for body text and functional elements.
A calming and trustworthy palette of deep forest greens, subtle minty accents, and off-white backgrounds is used consistently, with dark grey-green text for readability.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections slide up and fade into view.
The site features a dedicated 'How it works' section that visually breaks down a multi-step process using a central graphic (phone mockup) and surrounding descriptive text blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a background image that parallaxes subtly behind the main content as the user scrolls, creating depth. This effect is likely achieved using a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll.

Content sections are revealed with a gentle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement without being overly distracting. This is a common pattern with scroll-based animation libraries.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, ensuring persistent access to key links and calls to action throughout the user's journey on the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body text) with generous line height, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, creating a balanced and readable hierarchy. Small uppercase labels provide clear section demarcation and metadata.

standout: The site's design stands out through its serene and almost illustrative hero imagery combined with an elegant, editorial serif typeface for headings. This creates a distinctive, calming, and trustworthy aesthetic that feels more sophisticated and less clinical than typical health-related platforms, making complex topics feel approachable.
